Name: A Game For Alexander
Overview:
A Game For Alexander is a game made for 8 month old toddler Alexander by his gamer dad. Since Alexander isn't old enough yet to shoot aliens or dodge space rocks, this game was developed with his skillset as a gamer in mind.

Pressing the different buttons or moving the analog stick will trigger things to happen on screen. For example, pressing the blue X button will make the screen flash blue followed by a voice naming the color. Moving the analog stick will create a colorful trail which the player can sweep over the screen. Pressing the other buttons will trigger different actions on screen, such as farting noises and much more.
